topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I step into the room, and there it is, sitting on the desk where I’d least expect to find it. A stack of papers, bound neatly, a title in bold letters. How could they? I mean, it's me on every page, the plot of my life, our life, twisted into some kind of story. I didn’t sign up to be a character, to be watched and written about. I flip through the pages, my eyes scanning the words that claim to know me. Maybe it’s impressive, the way they’ve put it all down, the good and the not so good. But it’s not art, it’s an intrusion, a leak of the most intimate parts of us. I close the folder with a firm hand, the silence in the room a heavy blanket. We need to talk, but the words are stuck, tangled in the lies of fiction.
